name: Relic Researcher (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): An investigator with this talent can attempt to determine the properties of a magic item without using the detect magic or identify spells. Attempting to ascertain the item’s properties in this manner increases the amount of time required to make the check to 3 minutes.
